title: Microsoft 365 Copilot: federated connectors can create, update and delete in third-party systems
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, licensing, approval behavior and documented controls are supported. Minor corrections should qualify persistent approvals and tool-blocking enforcement, acknowledge conflicting Word and PowerPoint availability guidance, and remove checklist instructions without a matching controls row.
